steps.meaning: St. Vincent regional hospital holds a certain number of usable blood units at the deadline (Friday July 24, 2026, 12:00 PM PDT).
steps.name: hospital_holds_units_at_deadline

steps.meaning: The hospital's inventory at deadline equals its initial stock (15 units) plus any units received from shipments that arrived before the deadline.
steps.name: initial_stock_plus_received_shipments

steps.meaning: St. Vincent regional hospital held 15 usable units at 9:00 AM on Monday July 20, 2026.
steps.name: hospital_initial_stock

steps.meaning: The Tuesday shipment (150 units) is dispatched from the centre at 4:00 PM PDT and arrives at the hospital after about 3 hours, i.e., around 7:00 PM PDT on Tuesday July 21, 2026.
steps.name: shipment_tuesday_arrives

steps.meaning: The Thursday shipment (150 units) is dispatched from the centre at 4:00 PM PDT and arrives at the hospital after about 3 hours, i.e., around 7:00 PM PDT on Thursday July 23, 2026.
steps.name: shipment_thursday_arrives

steps.meaning: The centre has at least 150 usable units in stock at the time of Tuesday's dispatch (4:00 PM PDT on Tuesday July 21, 2026).
steps.name: centre_has_enough_stock_tuesday

steps.meaning: The centre has at least 150 usable units in stock at the time of Thursday's dispatch (4:00 PM PDT on Thursday July 23, 2026).
steps.name: centre_has_enough_stock_thursday

steps.meaning: The centre held 40 usable units in stock at 9:00 AM on Monday July 20, 2026.

steps.meaning: The mobile collection drive operates on Monday July 20, 2026 from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM PDT, collecting at 12 units per hour, yielding 96 units.
